//functionTimeout: Explicit rather than relying on the implicit Dedicated-plan default. Kept at 30 minutes ON PURPOSE: the PowerShell worker runs a limited number of invocations at a time, so a timer that runs for an hour can starve the HTTP endpoints the portal calls. A run that needs longer than this is a bug to fix, not a ceiling to raise.
//extensions.queues: The cost ingest's work queue (ProcessCostTask-Queue). batchSize 1 / newBatchThreshold 0: one task at a time — Cost Management's quota is per tenant, so parallel queries only buy more throttling, and one task leaves the worker's other slots to the portal's API. messageEncoding none: Add-QueueMessage (profile.ps1) writes plain JSON. visibilityTimeout: a task that throws is retried after a minute, at most maxDequeueCount times.
